title: Authorization Before Context: A Model-Neutral Audience Boundary Against Cross-Audience Memory Leakage in Agentic Systems
abstract: arXiv:2608.17148v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A personal language agent learns a fact from one audience and may later place it in the prompt it assembles for another. This memory-to-context step is an attack surface: ambiguous or inconsistent channels, cross-audience prying, and poisoned memory can each cause the system to assemble context containing a fact relevant to the query yet unauthorized for the current viewers. We introduce authorization before context: a single, anti-monotone audience-membership rule applied at the memory-to-context transition. Each item carries the audience present when it was recorded; the current viewer set is read from channel metadata and falls back to public when ambiguous; and the item is admitted only when every current viewer already belonged to its audience. We prove that this rule gives every participant cross-channel recall while ensuring, by exclusion rather than by model behavior, that nothing recorded for a narrower audience reaches a broa

translated_title: 授权先于上下文：针对智能体系统中跨受众记忆泄漏的模型无关受众边界
translated_abstract: 个人语言智能体从一个受众那里学习一个事实，并可能在之后将其放入为另一个受众构建的提示中。这个从记忆到上下文的步骤是一个攻击面：模糊或不一致的渠道、跨受众窥探以及被污染的记忆，都可能导致系统组装出包含与查询相关但对当前观众未授权事实的上下文。我们引入了“授权先于上下文”的方法：在记忆到上下文转换时应用一个单一的、反单调的受众成员规则。每个记忆项携带其记录时的受众；当前观众集合从渠道元数据中读取，在模糊时回退为公开；只有当每个当前观众都已属于该记忆项的受众时，该记忆项才被允许进入。我们证明，该规则为每个参与者提供了跨渠道回忆，同时通过排除而非模型行为，确保为较窄受众记录的内容不会到达较广的受众。
tldr: 本文提出“授权先于上下文”的模型无关规则，在记忆到上下文转换时应用受众成员检查，通过排除机制确保跨受众记忆泄漏被阻止，同时保持跨渠道回忆能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an "authorization before context" model-neutral rule applied at the memory-to-context transition, using an audience-membership check to prevent cross-audience memory leakage via exclusion while preserving cross-channel recall.
